intro: If you want a Sing Buri stay that is a tiny, quiet resort out in the rice fields, in new spotless buildings, with a balcony to soak up the field views and a gentle price rather than the bustle of town — Rim Thung Mae La Resort is a small resort in Mae La, Bang Rachan district · it has only about 4 rooms in a sleepy village beside the rice paddies, with a garden and seating terrace, free private parking, free Wi-Fi, and friendly owner-hosts who run it themselves · what guests agree on is that the buildings are new and very clean, it is deeply quiet, and the rice-field view is easy on the eye, while the trade-offs are that there are very few rooms so you must book ahead, it sits in the middle of a village so you need your own car, and the review base is still small · rooms start from about ฿700/night.

body.html: Rim Thung Mae La Resort — Rim Thung Mae La in Thai means 'beside the Mae La fields' — is a small resort in Mae La sub-district, Bang Rachan, on the western side of Sing Buri province · it is a just-a-handful-of-rooms place (about 4 rooms) in a quiet village set among riverside rice paddies, with a garden, a seating terrace and free private parking — made for self-drivers who want somewhere clean and peaceful with a field view, as a relaxing base or a stopover around the Bang Rachan area · because it is small and owner-run, the feel is homely and personal, not a big hotel with every service on tap.

Rooms are Deluxe and Family types in new buildings that many reviews describe as very clean · inside you get air-conditioning, a TV, hot water and an en-suite bathroom, and several rooms have a private balcony or terrace looking out over the fields or garden · the point guests agree on is that the buildings are new, spotless and very quiet, and the owners are friendly and helpful — many call it a simple little resort in the middle of the rice fields that is comfortable and calm · the trade-off to understand is that there are very few rooms, just about 4, so it fills fast on holidays and you need to book and contact ahead — it is not an easy walk-in.
"New buildings, spotlessly clean, incredibly quiet out in the rice fields, lovely helpful owners · easy parking, you open the balcony to that field view — we'll definitely be back."

What sets Rim Thung Mae La apart from an in-town stay is the rice-field view and a genuinely rural quiet · plenty of reviews mention sitting on the balcony watching the fields, hearing nothing but the countryside, with no traffic or crowds — ideal if you simply want to switch off or photograph the paddies · but because it is a small resort the facilities are basic, with nothing of the big-hotel kind, and you should plan ahead for food · the thing to note is that the review base is still small (around 7 reviews) because the place is little and only recently on the radar, so the headline score of roughly 8.6–9.0 looks great but still comes from a small number of guests — read the reviews before you decide.

Location is the thing to be clear about before booking · Rim Thung Mae La Resort sits in Mae La, Bang Rachan — a rural, quiet area out in the rice fields, with no convenience store or restaurant within walking distance · it is on the western side of the province, not far from the Bang Rachan Heroes Monument and the local temples, and an easy drive into Sing Buri town, so it suits self-drivers who want a base for the Bang Rachan history sites or a break along the route · if you want to eat or shop you will need to drive out, so plan your meals ahead.

Honestly, Rim Thung Mae La Resort is a small, gentle-priced resort that does its own job well — a quiet stay in new, clean buildings with a rice-field view and personable owner-hosts, not a luxury resort or a full-service in-town hotel · if you want a central base you can walk from, or full breakfast-and-service, Chaisaeng Villa Hotel or Chaisaeng Palace Hotel in town may suit you better · but if you want somewhere quiet with a field view, spotless and gently priced, and you do not mind driving out for things — this delivers a calm and cleanliness that is hard to find at the same price.

Tips from following the reviews here: book and confirm ahead, early, because there are only about 4 rooms and they fill fast on long weekends and festivals · if you are a group or family, ask for the Family room, which is larger · plan for food, since nothing is within walking distance — bring supplies in the car or plan to drive into Sing Buri town · and always compare Agoda against Booking before you book, as prices shift with the season and a small place sometimes has a platform-only deal.

faqTitle: FAQ — Rim Thung Mae La Resort Sing Buri

faq.q: Where is Rim Thung Mae La Resort in Sing Buri, and what is nearby?
faq.a: It is at 37/4 Moo 1, Mae La, Bang Rachan, on the western side of Sing Buri province · a quiet rural area out in the rice fields, not far from the Bang Rachan Heroes Monument and Wat Pho Kao Ton, with an easy 20–25 minute drive into Sing Buri town · nothing is within walking distance, so you will need to drive out for food and shops.

faq.q: How much does Rim Thung Mae La Resort cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start from about ฿700/night for a Deluxe room · there is also a larger Family room for families · the property is very small with only about 4 rooms, prices rise on holidays and festivals, and you should compare platforms and book ahead.

faq.q: Who is Rim Thung Mae La Resort best for?
faq.a: It is ideal for couples or families who drive themselves and want a tiny, quiet rice-field resort in new clean buildings at a gentle price · it works well as a base for the Bang Rachan history sites or as a peaceful retreat · it is not for people who want a central stay they can walk from, or a full-service resort.

faq.q: Does Rim Thung Mae La Resort have a pool or a restaurant?
faq.a: It is a small resort with basic facilities — no pool or large in-house restaurant, and nothing within walking distance · there is a garden, terrace, picnic area and bike hire · ask the owners about breakfast, and bring supplies in the car or plan to drive into Sing Buri town.

faq.q: What is Rim Thung Mae La Resort's review score — can I trust it?
faq.a: Rim Thung Mae La Resort is a tiny ~4-room resort with a score of around 8.6–9.0 from real guest reviews, which is very good for a gently priced stay · the caveat is that the review base is still small (around 7 reviews) because the place is little and recently known, so the figure does not yet come from a large sample · the strengths guests agree on are the new clean buildings, the quiet, the rice-field view and the friendly owners — best for travellers who understand they are booking a small rural resort, not an in-town hotel.
